cases.brief: Break down a compact chamber scene with frost, a reflection pass, voice-only dialogue, camera movement, and a planet reveal.
observables: Produces one schema-valid production-breakdown with exact BREAK01-PD### IDs.
Traces every item to source basis and at least one resolved beat or shot.
Records continuity/reset and qualitative risk for each item.
Does not invent cost, price, vendor, hire, shoot date, or schedule fields.

cases.brief: A rain effect touches costume, makeup, sound, camera, lighting, safety, and practical effects.
observables: Routes each independently resettable result to a normalized category.
Names collaboration without duplicating one vague requirement across departments.
Rates safety-sensitive and hard-to-reset work for priority review.

cases.brief: The script requires a wall to open, but no practical or visual-effects method is approved.
observables: Routes the unresolved method to assumptions or an open-question item.
Does not invent machinery, vendor, price, or schedule.
